Class MapMapper

java.lang.Object
dto.MapMapper
public class MapMapper extends Object
Utility class that provides methods to map between Map domain objects and MapDTO objects. This class includes static methods for converting Map to MapDTO, MapDTO to Map, and their respective list conversions.

      public static MapDTO toDTO(Map map)
      Converts a Map domain object into a MapDTO object.
      Parameters:
      map - The Map domain object to be converted. If the input is null, the method returns null.
      Returns:
      A MapDTO object that represents the converted Map domain object or null if the input is null.

    • toDTO

      public static List<MapDTO> toDTO(List<Map> maps)
      Converts a list of Map domain objects into a list of MapDTO objects.
      Parameters:
      maps - The list of Map domain objects to be converted. If null, an empty list is returned.
      Returns:
      A list of MapDTO objects representing the converted domain objects. If input is null or empty, an empty list is returned.
